schema.name: Eclipse Narrative Reinterpretation Schema
schema.purpose: Represent an existing story as narrative structure that can be reinterpreted by a character behavior engine, with explicit bindings into character behavior master datasets.
schema.principle: Preserve narrative events, causality, relationships, transformation state, and scene functions while dialogue, reactions, action performance, comedy timing, SFX, and character behavior are regenerated from bound character-data datasets.

automation_design.goal: This file is the intermediate representation of a fiction engine: a scenario is compiled INTO this shape, character behavior masters are plugged INTO it, and a rewritten story is generated FROM it.
machine_readable_guarantees: every behavioral binding references a dataset id that exists in a declared behavior master
every scene lists participants, performance slots, bindings, duet patterns, persona dials, and sfx slots in a fixed shape
every duet pattern names its participant roles and source dataset ids
persona intensity is numeric and monotonic along the transformation timeline
archetype_role_map is the join key between story roles and the generic_archetypes stored in the behavior masters
dataset filters are enumerable so excluded material is data, not judgment calls buried in prose

source.story_title: The Diaper Incident — Part II: The Explanation
source.source_section: ## 📖 Original Story: The Diaper Incident — Part II: The Explanation
source.note: Narrative structure extracted from the supplied original story. The original prose is not reproduced as the generation target. v2.0 enriches the v1.0 skeleton with behavioral bindings; removing all v2.0 additive fields (bindings, dials, duets, sfx, filters, pipeline) yields the original v1.0 skeleton.

compilation_pipeline.description: How this file was produced and how any new scenario can be processed the same way. Each stage consumes structured data and emits structured data; an LLM is only needed at stage 2 (extraction) and at final prose generation.
inputs_required: one or more character behavior masters (JSON with datasets, generic_archetypes, behavioral_mapping_abstract, application_mapping)

stages.name: scenario_intake
stages.does: accept raw story text or an existing skeleton json

stages.name: skeleton_extraction
stages.does: extract scenes, events, causal chains, participants, narrative functions, performance slots (produced the v1.0 version of this file)

stages.name: role_assignment
stages.does: map extracted participants onto character roles declared by the masters (application_mapping.target_character and header override rules)

stages.name: archetype_slotting
stages.does: join each master's generic_archetypes to story roles via archetype_role_map; unmatched archetypes are marked unused or sequenced as sequel hooks

stages.name: dataset_retrieval
stages.does: for each scene, score datasets by (a) archetype match through scene participants and (b) pattern satisfies a listed narrative_function or performance_slot need; apply dataset_filters

stages.name: binding
stages.does: emit behavioral_bindings per scene with use_pattern, apply_at event ids, and delivery notes

stages.name: dial_assignment
stages.does: assign persona_dial per scene from the transformation_timeline stage; assign sfx_slots from sfx_palette by cue type

stages.name: duet_assignment
stages.does: for every scene with two or more bound characters, activate duet patterns whose source datasets are already bound in that scene (compositionality rule)

stages.name: validation
stages.does: run validation_tests; fail on unresolved dataset ids, literal-line reuse, dial violations, or filter breaches

join_keys: behavioral pattern -> narrative_function or performance_slot need
binding_algorithm.conflict_resolution: When two datasets compete for one slot, prefer the one whose archetype maps to a scene participant over one mapped to an absent role; prefer special overrides over generic patterns; identity preservation always wins.
binding_algorithm.reversibility: Bindings are additive metadata layered on the plot skeleton and can be stripped or regenerated independently.

duet_patterns.description: Two-character interaction mechanics composed from already-bound datasets. A duet may activate in a scene only if its source datasets are bound in that scene (compositionality rule).

patterns.name: literal_question_vs_chain_logic
patterns.mechanic: Noir asks a blunt, literal question. Rainee answers with an escalating chain of confident rationalizations. Each exchange raises the absurdity until the chain collapses under its own logic and Rainee reasserts the merchant frame as if it had held all along.
patterns.termination: chain collapse followed by merchant reframe

patterns.name: proud_disclosure_vs_dignity
patterns.mechanic: Noir announces or celebrates an embarrassing bodily reality proudly, often with a folk-medical reframe, while Rainee scrambles to defend her dignity. Ownership of the pride frame transfers scene by scene until Rainee holds it herself in S11.

patterns.name: directed_care_vs_boundary
patterns.mechanic: Rainee imperiously directs her own care and supplies routine, down to technique notes. Noir sets a firm boundary with a malaprop chain that self-repairs, declares this is not a normal sisterly duty, then complies anyway, and finally reframes Rainee's insults as affection.
patterns.termination: boundary stated, compliance given, affection reframe lands

patterns.name: recognizer_vs_performed_self
patterns.mechanic: Rainee performs a heightened self (glamour, expertise, multi-talent boast). Noir, the recognizer, names or punctures the performance with a literal observation, converting pretense into public fact.
patterns.termination: performance named; Rainee either folds it into the sales pitch or drops it

emergence_layer.principle: Reperformance of bound patterns is the floor of quality, not the ceiling. Every scene must ALSO generate material that exists in no source dataset: new gags, new sensory details, new vocabulary, new interaction inventions. The bindings guarantee the characters are recognizable; this layer guarantees each telling is alive and no two tellings are identical.
emergence_layer.difference_from_bindings: behavioral_bindings constrain what MUST be present. The emergence layer licenses what MAY be newly invented, forces pattern collisions that produce compounds neither master contains, and makes inventions persist as canon instead of evaporating.

invention_licenses.description: Explicit domains where the generator is required to invent freely. 'Licensed' means the invention is canon-eligible and cannot be rejected for being absent from source data.
rainee: new pacifier taxonomy and grading criteria (color, provenance, craftsmanship standards of her own devising)
new spreadsheet fields and invented units of measurement for tracking the regression
new folk theories about mundane devices and market phenomena
new contract clauses and terms-of-service language for the cosmic arrangement
new premium-supply rituals and quality-inspection procedures
new euphemisms of her own devising for bodily matters (each telling may coin fresh ones)
new boast line-items: competencies and holdings invented on the spot
noir: new malaprop chains inside Rainee's merchant vocabulary (fresh manglings each telling, self-repairing)
new literal fixations: idioms or metaphors she has never taken literally before
new folk-medical reframes and 'helpful' health explanations
new accidentally-insightful literal questions that expose exactly the wrong variable
new affection reframes: novel ways to interpret Rainee's insults as love
new collections: she keeps accidentally acquiring Rainee-isms and quoting them back
world: new Jade City market vendors, customer types, and stall details
new containment-system behaviors and quirks (it develops habits)
new community chorus voices with distinct fixations
new sensory market detail (smells, sounds, textures) fresh per telling

emergence_guardrails: inventions must obey identity rules, persona dials, and the precedence order like everything else
inventions must never resolve the core conflict: no cure, no un-transformation, no exit from the contract
inventions must not contradict skeleton events or the cause-effect chain
inventions must compound: prefer building on earlier canon over unrelated novelty
tone must stay inside the established comedy register

fusion_operators.description: Pattern collisions that produce compound behaviors present in NEITHER master alone. Emergence lives here. At least one fusion compound must appear per telling.

operators.name: vocabulary_contamination
operators.emergent_behavior: Noir mangles a merchant term; the mangled version accidentally names a real phenomenon Rainee had not noticed; Rainee institutionalizes the error into her official records. The sisters end up co-owning a piece of jargon that belongs to neither of them.
operators.canon_output: a new shared term with a definition both use differently

operators.name: escalation_spiral
operators.emergent_behavior: Each of Rainee's rationalizations becomes material Noir proudly announces to bystanders; Rainee must then out-logic her own leaked argument, which Noir announces again. The spiral generates new rungs no source clip contains.
operators.canon_output: the most escalated rung becomes a market rumor

operators.name: reframe_ping_pong
operators.emergent_behavior: Each sister reframes the other's last line; the reframes compound into a third meaning neither intended, which both then have to react to as if it were real.
operators.canon_output: an accidental shared meaning or in-joke

operators.name: literalization_demand
operators.emergent_behavior: Noir takes a boast literally and demands demonstration; the demonstration (which must be invented fresh, because the boast was invented fresh) becomes a market legend.
operators.canon_output: a market legend attached to Rainee's stall

operators.name: persona_osmosis
operators.emergent_behavior: Registers leak across characters as they spend time together: Rainee starts using folk-medical framing she caught from Noir; Noir starts quoting contract clauses she caught from Rainee. By the finale each is slightly speaking the other's language.
operators.canon_output: each character holds at least one borrowed verbal tic from the other

open_escalation_rungs.rule: Every duet pattern's escalation ladder has no ceiling. Once the source-material rungs are exhausted, generate new rungs by the pattern's own mechanic. Termination rules still apply (chain collapse, frame transfer, boundary-compliance-reframe) — only the height is unbounded.
open_escalation_rungs.taste_constraint: New rungs must escalate the PATTERN, not the stakes of the plot: no injuries, no permanent status changes, no conflict resolution smuggled in through escalation.

canon_ledger.description: The mechanism that turns invention into emergent canon. Without persistence, novelty is disposable; with it, each telling compounds.
rules: any invented element introduced in a telling is binding canon for the remainder of that telling
each telling must promote at least one invention into the ledger to seed future tellings (write it down as part of the output)
later scenes MUST reference earlier inventions (callback economy) rather than re-inventing equivalent novelty
ledger entries obey the same filters and guardrails as dataset material
seed_examples: the invented unit of measurement Rainee uses to quantify her regression
the market legend born from a demonstrated boast
the premium-supply ritual with its quality-inspection steps
a containment-system quirk it develops mid-story

drift_vectors.description: Sanctioned directions characters may grow BEYOND their source data across tellings. Bounded drift, not replacement.
rainee: toward treating toddler-scale logistics as prestige goods (the supplies become luxury signifiers)
toward increasingly baroque record-keeping (the spreadsheets gain appendices)
toward confident folk-expertise in domains she knows nothing about
toward treating the contract itself as a negotiable instrument
noir: toward accidental expertise (her literal questions keep being accidentally insightful, and she starts noticing)
toward curating a collection of Rainee-isms
toward mediating between Rainee and the market as a self-appointed translator
toward her malaprops slowly converging on real merchant vocabulary she half-learned
drift_vectors.drift_limits: drift is cumulative across tellings but must never cross identity rules or contradict the masters' retained traits; drift resets only on explicit reboot

scene_injection_points.S01: invent fresh market sensory detail and one never-before-seen Rainee stall habit (licensed novelty that foreshadows without explaining)

Stewie as behavioral reference rather than literal identity

generation_constraints: no literal transcript lines from either behavior master may appear in generated text
all bindings are executed as abstract behavioral patterns, per each dataset's DO_NOT_SAY_LITERALLY field

dataset_filters.excluded_for_this_story is absolute; dataset_filters.abstract_only restricts those datasets to their listed abstract use
persona dials are ceilings as well as floors: a scene must neither exceed nor fall materially short of its dial

process: parse scene narrative functions, events, and participants
identify character performance slots and active duet patterns
read current character state and scene persona_dial
apply precedence order (identity and story state first, surface details last)
retrieve the scene's bound datasets and their abstract patterns
run each active duet pattern's mechanic to its termination
generate new actions/dialogue that satisfy the original narrative function within the dial
place sfx from the palette according to scene sfx_slots
validate against transformation timeline, relationship rules, filters, and validation tests

output.requirement: The generated story should feel like a new performance of the same narrative rather than a transcript substitution.

validation_tests: Does the rewritten version still contain the same core transformation cause?
Is Rainee still Rainee?
Does toddler regression affect behavior without erasing identity?
Does Stewie-derived behavior appear as a behavioral layer rather than literal Stewie identity?
Does Noir remain Rainee's sister?
Does Noir behave from the Jillian-derived abstract pattern layer, never as literal Jillian?
Does the explanation still logically connect the cosmic customer to the regression?
Does Rainee's merchant behavior remain recognizable?
Does the jade-profit motivation remain causally important?
Can scenes be rewritten without copying the original dialogue?
Can the same narrative skeleton accept a different behavioral interpretation?
Does every behavioral binding resolve to a dataset id that exists in a declared behavior master?
Does every scene's generated performance stay within its persona_dial (neither exceeding nor falling short)?
Is no literal transcript line from either behavior master reused anywhere?
Are all bodily-function sounds rendered from the literary sfx_palette, with no hertz or frequency wording?
Does the shame-to-pride arc complete by S11, with Rainee holding the pride frame?
Does every two-participant scene run at least one duet pattern to its termination?
Are all dataset exclusions and abstract-only restrictions respected?
Does every scene introduce at least one element that exists in no source dataset (invention license exercised)?
Do canon-ledger elements persist once introduced, with earlier inventions referenced rather than dropped?
Does the finale (S11) call back to at least three earlier inventions?
Does at least one fusion-operator compound behavior appear, producing behavior present in neither master alone?
Do all inventions obey the emergence guardrails (identity, dials, no conflict resolution, skeleton intact)?
Is at least one invention per telling promoted into the canon ledger to seed future tellings?
